resources.string: Create a project from TXT or open a .lnt file. TXT originals can be up to 8 MiB.
No projects yet. Choose a TXT or .lnt file to begin.
Existing library data is preserved. Migration to projects is not available yet.
%1$d project folders need recovery. Existing projects are preserved.
The private project could not be opened. Refresh or import a saved copy.
Terms, text protection, replacements, presets and prompt templates.
Endpoint, protocol, model and API keys used by Agent and translation.
Target language, deduplication and translated-name writeback.
Project location, assets and output cleanup.
Follow the system, or force the light or dark theme.
Notification permission is granted. Running translations can show progress and stop actions.
Notification permission is missing. Background progress and the stop action may not appear.
Formats with a registered writer in this build. Support still requires a round-trip file check.
Bounded, redacted runtime events. Export for support or clear after review.
Only redacted operational metadata is recorded. Prompts, source text, response bodies and credentials are never logged.
No diagnostics have been recorded yet.
Clear all recorded diagnostics? This cannot be undone.
Model endpoint, price table, rule presets and prompt templates in one versioned ZIP. This is not a full application backup.
API keys, OAuth tokens, project instances, Agent chats, translation queue, diagnostics and execution approvals are excluded. Re-enter credentials after restoring.
Application config restored; projects, chats and credentials are not restored. Re-enter credentials.
Projects, visible Agent sessions, read-only approval/queue/run history, usage and price facts, app settings and optional diagnostics in one versioned ZIP. It is not a credential backup.

Restore creates new project instances. Approvals, queued/running tasks and execution tokens are never restored as executable; re-authenticate after restoring. Stop Agent/translation/queue work and resolve pending approvals first.
Full application backup restored; approvals, queue and runs are read-only history. Re-enter credentials.

This ZIP includes project snapshots, Agent sessions, approval and queue history, usage/price facts and app settings. API keys, OAuth/MCP tokens, key state, checkpoint bodies and execution authorization are excluded.
Off by default. When enabled, the redacted diagnostic log is added to this archive.

Projects will be imported as new instances. Approval, queue and RUNNING history is restored read-only (or PAUSED/NEEDS_REVIEW); pending approvals and execution tokens are not restored. Nothing starts automatically. Credentials are not included. The restore is rejected unless the app has no active Agent, translation, running queue or pending approval.
Full backup was not restored: stop active Agent/translation/queue work and clear pending approvals first.
User skill files and built-in definitions available to the Agent. Editing does not execute them.
Built-in skills are read-only. User skills live only in private app storage and are never executed from this screen.
Built-in skill: content and metadata are read-only.
Delete “%1$s”? This removes the user skill files and cannot be undone.
Could not update the skill library
Comma- or line-separated. Languages: up to %1$d values of 32 characters; tags: up to %2$d values of 64 characters.
Check the name, order, languages and tags.
This skill changed elsewhere. Your draft is kept; cancel and reopen it to use the latest version.
Limits: %1$d ms, %2$d B output, %3$d B artifacts, %4$d B changes.
Name, body and order edits keep this policy unchanged.
The built-in policy is defined by its read-only package.
Agent chat is not available in this build. You can edit text and save your project.
Translate from the proofreading page after configuring a model on the Agent page. Manual editing and export remain available.
Only processed entries use their saved translation, including empty text. Other entries use the original. Identical original and translated lines are shown once in bilingual output.
Import TXT or EPUB files. Source files are stored in the project.
This asset has no text entries. The original file is preserved.
Operation cancelled. Refresh to check any changes already saved.
The saved entry has changed. Your draft is preserved. Reload the saved value before trying again.
Your unsaved changes will be lost.
The file or text exceeds the supported limit.
The text cannot be decoded. Check the selected encoding.
This project version is not supported.
This file is not a supported LNT TXT project, or its contents are damaged.
Only EPUB and TXT imports are active. Other format adapters are frozen; existing projects and files are kept.
Active import formats: EPUB and TXT. Other format adapters are frozen and are not part of the active product scope.
EPUB imported, but it uses a fixed layout. Translation keeps the package structure and text slots; exact visual pagination is not guaranteed.
EPUB imported. Non-linear spine documents are skipped to keep reading order; their text is not translated.
EPUB imported. Some text containing an unknown XML entity was kept unchanged instead of being guessed.
The operation could not finish. Existing project data is preserved.
Another operation is still running. Try again after it finishes.
Access to the selected file was denied. Select the file again.
Temporary exports cleared. Saved projects are unchanged.

This is a local workflow test, not a real translation. It writes [SIMULATION] plus the original text into nonblank, unprocessed entries on this page only. Saved and excluded entries stay unchanged. Duplicate your project first if needed. No network or paid requests are made.
Local simulation finished. Saved results are kept.
Local workflow buttons use Koog without network access. Configure a remote model for conversation. The manual proposal form tests approval and does not generate model text.
One entry will be replaced with the proposed translation and marked processed. Approval applies once to this fixed difference.
The result is unresolved. Refresh to check the project receipt; it will not execute automatically.
Recovered an interrupted tool call. The tool was not re-run; ask the agent to check the current state.

Configure a compatible Chat Completions endpoint. HTTP and HTTPS are supported. API key is optional; a non-empty key is encrypted on this device. Saving does not send a request. Fetch models only queries the model list.
Configure a model to send messages. Local workflow buttons work without a model.
Sending shares the conversation and requested source text with the selected endpoint and may incur charges. Edits require approval.
Model authentication failed. Check the configuration. No automatic retry.
The model request failed or timed out. No automatic retry; the request may have reached the provider.
The provider is busy or rate limited. No automatic retry.
Conversation budget exceeded. Start a new chat.
The model response was incomplete or invalid. Saved project results are kept.
The request result needs reconciliation. It will not be sent again automatically.
Conversation history is incomplete or invalid. Start a new chat; existing records are kept.
Some Agent data could not be verified. Refresh or reopen the project. Approval and sending are disabled until verification succeeds.
Check the HTTP/HTTPS API base, model ID and API key. URLs cannot contain credentials, query parameters or fragments. A non-empty key must use printable ASCII without spaces.
The run was interrupted. Saved changes remain. Check the project before starting a new run; nothing is replayed automatically.
A request or commit could not be confirmed. Check saved changes and provider usage before sending a new request, which may incur another charge. Nothing is retried automatically.
Run recovery could not be loaded. Refresh before starting another task.
Use an API base such as http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 or a LAN address. A pasted /chat/completions or /models suffix is removed. localhost refers to this Android device.
HTTP is unencrypted. Use it for a trusted local or LAN service.
Use saved API key (same endpoint only)
Keys are tried in order only by an explicit retry. Leave empty and keep the saved key to reuse it.
No models returned. You can still enter a model ID manually.
Model list authentication failed. Check the key or enter a model ID manually.
Could not fetch models. Check the endpoint, or enter a model ID manually.
Source: explicit empty result (overrides the saved list)
This live probe result is not saved. Use Refresh catalog to keep it.
The endpoint returned no models. Enter a model ID manually.
Could not read the saved model catalog.
Save this profile first to load or probe its catalog.
Metadata probe succeeded: %1$d models in %2$d ms.
Generation probe succeeded: %1$d output characters in %2$d ms.
The result is shown here only. It does not change the profile or saved defaults.
A matching price is configured (%1$s %2$s per 1M output tokens). This probe sends one short request with up to %3$d output tokens and may still be billed. This is not a billing statement.
No matching price is configured for this model. The provider may still bill this probe (one short request, up to %1$d output tokens). Unknown is not free. This is not a billing statement.
Provider rejected the request or content
Ask about the source, read specific items, or propose a translation. Project changes require your approval. Local tools work without a model.
Review the pending change before continuing the conversation.
Tool activity — open the message for details.
Only the latest output is shown here. The full reply is recorded after completion.
This partial preview stays only on this page and has not been committed as a complete reply.
Could not start background processing. Saved results are kept. Try again while the app is visible.
Local simulation can continue while you leave the app. System limits or process termination can interrupt it; saved results are kept. Notifications are optional.
The project view could not be refreshed. The task is still attached; you can stop it here. Saved results are kept.
Case-sensitive literal text; no wildcards or regular expressions.
Edits keep the current page members. Apply again to refresh membership.
Clear filters to run the page simulation.
Change %1$d affected entries: %2$s. Only this fixed selection is included.
This clears the selected translations and marks them unprocessed.
A failed attempt retains this exact batch. Confirm again to reconcile or retry it.
The project changed. Close this preview, refresh and prepare a new selection.
The selection already has these values.
The batch was applied, but the page could not refresh. Refresh to read the saved results.

Process every unprocessed, nonblank item in this project with the local simulation. Existing processed and excluded items stay as they are. Each completed batch is saved; stopping keeps saved results. No model request is sent and no automatic restart occurs. The view returns to the first page.
Statistics for this run only. Missing usage is unknown, not zero. These totals are not a billing statement.
This sends the selected source text and instructions to the displayed endpoint and may incur charges. Confirm the model, language and scope before starting.
Durable tasks are shown in admission order. A queued task runs only after the previous task settles.
Could not read the translation queue
Remote translation finished. Saved results are kept.
Configure a model on the Agent page before starting remote translation.

Only non-empty unprocessed items are translated. Results are saved in batches; stopping or later failure keeps saved results. There is no automatic retry or restart after process death. Single long items can exceed the batch character target.
Discard the unsaved rule and prompt changes?
Save or discard rule changes before starting translation.
Invalid rule or pattern, damaged protection markers, or rule budget exceeded. Check the highlighted rule.
Rules were saved, but refreshing the project failed. Reload before editing again.
Could not load project rules. Reload before editing or translating.
Choose a file format below. Import changes the draft after preview; Save commits it. Text export copies to the clipboard or saves to a selected file.
Preview: %1$d rules. Apply replaces the draft.
Patterns use the RE2 subset; look-around and pattern backreferences are unsupported. Replacement text uses backslash capture syntax; dollar references are literal.
Checks the full draft against saved project rules. Language choices apply only to this check. Script detection is a limited heuristic; a clear result is not proof of translation quality.
Save or reload project rules and resolve the editor conflict before checking.
Not evaluated: only nonblank processed translations are checked.
No issues found by these checks.
Source and translation are unusually similar
Source and translation have different line counts
Some matched glossary targets are missing
Protected text differs in content, order or line
These results are stale. Scan again or close them before paging.

Reads the entire project in bounded pages and checks saved translations within the current status/text query. No model requests or writes. Closing the app discards results. A change or failure cancels the whole scan.
Discard the current draft and open the adjacent matching item?
No more matching items in this direction.
Nonoverlapping replacement in this translation draft. Preview and apply keep the result in the draft; Save in the editor commits it.
Beginning of the resulting draft (up to 240 characters):
This replacement does not change the draft.
Retranslation sends translated text items again and may incur new charges. Existing translations remain until replacement is committed.
Preceding context lines (0–16, up to 2048 characters)
Extra requests may incur charges. Transient errors retry with backoff; protocol or size errors may split a batch. Authentication and filtered content stop immediately. Zero disables retries.
Reuse exact source text within the same file and run (plain entries only)
Remove %1$s and its %2$d entries from this project? The external source file is kept.
Clear translations and restore unprocessed status for all %2$d entries in %1$s?
Language values prefill future translation confirmations. Export preferences apply to future file saves. No request starts when saving settings.
Show identical source and translation only once in bilingual exports
Write translated names in supported RenPy and Message JSON exports
Project backup restored as a new project.
Matching: %1$d · Unprocessed %2$d · Processed %3$d · Excluded %4$d · Errors %5$d · Skipped %6$d · Duplicates %7$d
Batch actions for all query results
This preview freezes all affected query results. Confirmation applies this exact selection without rerunning or expanding the query.
The saved batch preview is missing or invalid. Nothing will be replayed automatically. Check saved results before preparing again.
Batch actions for all quality-filtered results
Replace all current rules with this preset
Library changes do not save the project. Preview and Apply update only its draft; save the project rules separately. Native LNT presets only.
Replace preset %1$s with the current project draft and entered name?
Delete preset %1$s from the library? Existing project rules are kept.
Preset operation failed. Reload the library and check for conflicts or limits.

Use {{variable}} with lowercase ASCII names. Parse, fill values and preview before applying. project_name, source_language and target_language are prefilled. Apply changes only the draft and keeps its current enabled setting.
Library changes never save the project or start a model. Select a template to load its body into the editor; parse, fill variables and preview before applying, then save the project rules.
Comma-separated language tags such as en or zh-cn. Leave empty to apply to every language.
Save current body as new template
Replace template %1$s with the current body and entered metadata?
Delete template %1$s from the library? Existing project prompts are kept.
Invalid name, order, language tag or body, or the library changed. Reload and try again.
Template library operation failed. Reload and check limits or conflicts.
Prepared: %1$d · Dispatched: %2$d · Responses: %3$d · Awaiting or unknown: %4$d
Could not read the ledger. Retry to load the saved facts.

Recorded locally since the ledger was introduced. Earlier requests are not reconstructed. Awaiting or missing receipts may still incur charges; unknown usage is not zero. Totals are not a billing statement.
Continue the original fixed targets and model configuration toward %1$s (%2$s)? Only uncommitted targets are eligible. This may incur charges.
Only recorded translation tasks are listed. Resume is explicit; uncertain requests or changed projects require review.
Cannot safely resume this task. Review request receipts and project changes first. Requests are never replayed automatically.
The model response could not be saved. Execution stopped. Review the request receipts; no paid retry will be started automatically.
Paused. Resume explicitly from translation tasks.
Pausing; waiting for the current request
Task stopped after failure. Start a new translation to retry remaining items.
Pages show locally recorded facts. Refresh to see newer requests or updated receipts. Unknown usage does not mean zero cost.
Each request uses the price version saved with it. Missing versions, missing prices and incomplete usage stay unknown; the current price table is never used to reprice older receipts.
Could not read historical costs. Retry to read saved facts.
Copy selected kind as LG JSON
External rules import into %1$s and keep the prompt. Preview and Save are required. Export requires all rules of this kind to be enabled.
Save selected kind as LG JSON file
Save selected kind as CSV file
Save selected kind as LG XLSX file
Merge new templates; report ID conflicts
Import native template JSON. Review the differences before confirming. Replace removes templates absent from the file. This changes only the library, not any project prompt.
The library changed since this draft was opened. Select the template again to review the current saved content.
Replace translations in the frozen query or quality-filter results. Original text and item status are preserved. Review the affected rows and confirm before saving.
RE2 regular expressions with JavaScript dollar substitutions. Lookaround and pattern backreferences are rejected.
One name per line. Source names are optional; translated names are written back only to formats that support names. Clearing both fields removes stored names.
One name per line; up to %1$d names and %2$d characters per name.
Names exceed the allowed count or length.
These drafts are stored for this Chat. “Use” moves one into the composer; it does not send or append history.
All projects restored as new instances.
Enter prices per million tokens in the selected currency. All five rates are required; enter 0 only for explicitly free components. Costs are recalculated using this table, not provider bills.
Invalid price, conflicting currency, changed table, or save failure. Close and reopen to reload.
Current price %1$s · known actual %2$s · estimated %3$s · table v%4$d
Some usage is unknown; the shown costs are incomplete.
Terminate this task? Committed translations, staged responses and all request receipts are retained. Uncertain requests stay uncertain. This does not retry or send a model request.
Task changed or decision could not be saved. Close and review again.
Select errors on this page. Preparing creates a separate fixed task with a new request budget. The next confirmation authorizes model requests. Previous receipts and successful items are retained.
Guidance accepted for the next tool-loop boundary.
Guidance was not accepted. Your text is retained.
Recorded states may be from an interrupted run. Injected means added to later request context, not proof the model acted. Restore only fills an empty draft after the run ends; it never sends.

Write a complete summary of earlier turns, including any previous summary. Saving replaces only earlier model context and keeps the last two user turns. Visible history, committed changes and usage remain. No model request is sent.
At least three completed turns are required. The conversation may have changed or saving failed; reopen to refresh.
Earlier messages remain available after context summarization. Previews are shortened; open details for full text, reasoning and tool receipts.

Create and select a new conversation through this message. Optional text edits affect the new branch only. Project changes and usage remain; old approvals and execution permissions are not copied. Nothing is sent.
Edit this text in the new branch
Cannot branch here: incomplete tools, pending approval, changed conversation, nonempty draft, or history budget exceeded.

Off by default. When enabled, sending a message may first request a summary from the selected model, adding usage and cost. Recent turns and the complete visible history are retained. Manual summaries remain available.
Summarizing context with the selected model…
Context summary saved; complete history remains available.
Automatic summary was not confirmed. Check the context if the next request fails.
If a selected item conflicts, reject the selected batch.
Commit independent selected items; record conflicts separately.
Partially saved. Remaining items need a new proposal.
Rejected because another selected item conflicts
The complete policy is committed together. Project or policy conflicts reject this proposal. Unsaved rule drafts are kept with their original baseline.

Decisions apply to translation targets and PDF export. Imported choice translates text pages and keeps empty pages. Keep copies the original page; omit removes it. Translate replaces the page with laid-out text and requires a saved translation. OCR and original graphics are not retained by text replacement.
Extracted text and saved translation only. This is not the original PDF layout.
Could not load this page. Close and reopen the page decisions to refresh the project revision.
Original page preview rendered on demand at reduced resolution. It is not an editable layout.
Could not render the original page. The extracted text preview is still available.
No extracted text. The page may be blank or contain an image.
The PDF is damaged or not a valid PDF. The original asset and project data were not changed.
This PDF is password-protected. Remove the password before importing it; the current project is unchanged.
PDF support is not available right now. Restart the app and try again; existing data is unchanged.
The PDF exceeds the supported size, page, text, or output limit.
A page decision no longer matches this PDF. Reopen the page settings and try again.
The PDF page plan contains a duplicate page. Reopen the page settings and try again.
A page is set to translate but has no saved translation. Add the translation or choose Keep.
Every page would be removed. Keep or translate at least one page.
Text could not be extracted from this PDF. The original asset was not changed.
The PDF page could not be rendered. The original asset was not changed.
No bundled font can display this page translation. Check uncommon characters or choose Keep.
This PDF has form fields or embedded files, so a page-changing export is refused to preserve the original.
PDF imported, but no page has an extractable text layer. Every page stays Keep; OCR is not run automatically.
PDF imported, but some pages have no extractable text and stay Keep.
PDF imported. It contains form fields, so a page-changing export is blocked to protect the original.
PDF imported. It contains embedded files, so a page-changing export is blocked to protect the original.
PDF imported. It contains form fields and embedded files, so a page-changing export is blocked to protect the original.
This approval changes only page handling: keep, omit, or translate. It does not include page text, translation text, or a layout preview.
If the project revision or PDF asset changed, reject the whole selected batch.
Commit selected pages whose base decision still matches; record conflicts separately.
Partially saved. Remaining pages need a new proposal.
Rejected because another selected page conflicts
The imported asset will be enabled.
The imported asset will be disabled.
Approval is fixed to this artifact SHA-256, target path, project revision and command. Any change requires a new proposal; a path conflict is decided by the project asset writer.
The artifact or project changed. Nothing was imported.
The import could not be committed. Nothing was imported.
Saving %1$s. Save commits the complete rules and prompt policy, including other sections.
Rules apply to body text. This native policy has no name-scope field, so name-only glossary scope is not available.
From the last completed local quality scan. Opening this page does not start a new scan.
Quality evidence is hidden until the draft matches the saved project revision.
No completed quality scan is available. Run a quality check from the proofreading page to show missing-term evidence here.
Local only, up to %1$d characters. The sample is never sent to a model or written to logs.
Uses enabled rules in this section only. It does not translate or save anything.
No enabled rules in this section.
Only the first matches are shown.
Only the beginning of the result is shown.
Stored in the project policy. Template library actions only change this draft; save to commit.
No built-in default prompt exists in this native policy. Use the template library or enter text.
An empty replacement deletes the match. Entered newlines are kept.
Generated materials and artifacts are read-only. You may add a file to uploads/; it becomes a workspace material, not a project asset or model image. Preview shows at most 64 KiB of UTF-8 text.
No manifest-approved materials for this revision.
No saved artifacts for this run.
Read-only preview of at most 64 KiB. Opening it does not save or apply anything.
This item is not available as bounded UTF-8 text.
Language, theme, automatic summaries and project scope.
Network timeouts, HTTP proxy, redirects and global request limits.
App-wide appearance, language and model transport. Project text settings stay with each project.
These settings apply to the whole app, not one project. Changing them does not modify project text or revisions.
Follow the system, or force the light or dark theme.
Choose the interface language. The current screen recreates immediately to apply it.
The open project, chat and drafts remain in the retained view model. Background work already running is not restarted and may finish with the previous language.
Automatic summaries can add model requests, token usage and provider cost before a user-started Agent turn.
Application-level style preference for the Agent. It is not a project rule.

The persona is sent only as untrusted text in the Agent system prompt. It cannot override safety, approval, tool permissions or project rules, and it is not written to project text, project backups, prompt templates, logs or credential storage.
Plain text. Line breaks and tabs are allowed; other control characters are rejected.
The persona is too long or contains unsupported control characters.
The persona could not be saved. Your draft is kept.
Source language, target language, bilingual deduplication and translated-name writeback are saved per project. Edit them from More → Project settings. They are not global settings.

Project data stays in app-private storage. Exporting or saving a project file, translation, backup or asset uses the Android document picker and the location you choose; there is no fixed global output folder. Interface language never changes project paths or previously exported files.
Storage statistics and cleanup remain on the More page. These settings do not move or delete project files.
Corrupt or unreadable saved settings reject model requests; the app does not silently use defaults or a direct connection. A configured proxy is used for HTTP and HTTPS, with no direct fallback.
Used by compatible-model HTTP calls for Agent, translation and model catalog discovery.
Saved network settings could not be read. Model requests fail closed instead of connecting directly. Fix or restore the saved settings, then reload.
Network settings changed elsewhere. Your form was kept. Reload saved values to compare, or save again to replace them.
Each timeout must be a whole number from 1 to 600 seconds. Proxy host and port must both be empty or both valid; do not embed credentials, schemes or paths in the host.
Saving failed. The form was kept; reload saved values or try again.
Defaults are in effect. No saved network override exists.
A saved network override is in effect.
Timeouts are in seconds. Defaults: connect 10, read 90, write 10, call 90.
IPv4 address or host name plus port. IPv6 brackets, schemes and paths are not supported. Username and password are configured separately below. Leave both empty for a direct connection.
Use a Basic username and password for proxy requests; they are stored encrypted on this device.
Credentials are encrypted with Android Keystore and are never shown again. They apply only to this proxy host and port.
An encrypted credential is attached to this proxy.
Leave both fields empty to keep the saved credential. Enter both to replace it.
Encrypted credential kept but detached from this proxy
Enter both proxy username and password. The username cannot contain a colon; both must be 1–512 printable characters without leading or trailing spaces.
The proxy credential could not be read or written. The saved network settings were not changed. No password is shown here.
The credential reference was removed, but its encrypted file could not be deleted.
Choose whether to keep the encrypted credential on this device. A kept credential is no longer used by this proxy and is never shown again. Deleting removes it from Keystore storage.
Enter a proxy host and port before enabling proxy authentication.
Off by default. When enabled, both HTTP and HTTPS redirects are followed.
Shared by Agent and translation inference requests. Model catalog discovery is a metadata GET and is not counted as an inference request.
Saved request limits could not be read. Requests fail closed instead of using an invented allowance. Fix or restore the saved limits, then reload.
Request limits changed elsewhere. Your form was kept. Reload saved values to compare, or save again to replace them.
Concurrency must be a whole number from 1 to 16; requests per minute must be a whole number from 0 to 60000.

New model resources use the saved limits. If a configuration was already scheduled in this process, its requests fail closed after a limit change until the app process restarts; new configurations use the saved values. This form does not resize an active pool.
Defaults: concurrency 4, RPM 0. RPM 0 uses a one-second token bucket sized by concurrency.
Could not save the language preference
Project-scoped assets, private storage, output cleanup and the real delivery and restore boundaries.
Frozen source assets in this project. Export opens the system save picker through the existing adapter; this page never writes a second copy.
No fixed assets in this project.
Read-only list of archive members with paths, sizes and storage flags.
Read-only; does not modify the archive or project.
Could not read this RGSS archive.
The archive exceeds the supported size or member limit.
This RGSS archive version is not supported.
The file is not a valid RGSS archive, or its member table is damaged.
These buttons use the existing LNT, project backup and all-project backup writers. Cancelling the system picker does not delete project data.
Calculated on demand from private app directories. These byte counts are not a device performance measurement.
Storage usage has not been calculated yet.

Temporary export snapshots live in cache. Cleanup removes only adapter-owned temporary files; project facts, source originals, workspace artifacts and files you saved outside the app are never deleted.
Failures are reported as errors. A failed cleanup is never shown as success.
No package here is a complete application restore. Restore creates new project instances and never overwrites an existing project.

One validated project snapshot: source assets, items, translations, project settings, revisions, receipts and archives. It excludes app settings, credentials, Agent chats, the translation queue and diagnostics.
manifest.json plus one validated .lnt snapshot. It excludes credentials, Agent chats, model settings, presets and templates. Missing or failed material is not reported as success.

Every readable project as an independent .lnt snapshot. Restore imports them sequentially as new instances; a later failure keeps earlier imports and is reported. This is not a cross-project transaction or a complete app restore.

Model endpoint without keys, price table, prompt templates and rule presets. It excludes project instances, credentials, Agent chats, translation queue and diagnostics. Re-enter credentials and do not treat it as a full application restore.
No debug detail was stored for this record.
Only this record is loaded. No source text, prompt, model response body or credential is requested.
This record is no longer available. Reload the list.
The log cursor is no longer valid. Reload newest records instead of continuing this page.

Exports every recorded diagnostic as JSONL. Messages are redacted. If debug details are enabled, the export can include extra body-adjacent context from new records. Prompts, credentials and full source text must never be logged; review the file before sharing.
Debug details are currently enabled. New records may contain sensitive context in the export.
Off by default. Enabling stores extra detail for new records only; existing records are unchanged. Detail may include sensitive body-adjacent context, so never enable it for routine sharing.
Enable debug details? New records may store extra text that is sensitive. This only affects future records.
Debug details are on for new records.
Debug details are off. New records store metadata only.
This review reads durable failure evidence for the same task. It never creates a new Run or task and never sends a model request by itself.
Could not read failure evidence. Refresh to review the current durable facts.
Only a bounded portion of the evidence was read. Refresh to continue.
Receipt uncertain · retry and skip unavailable; keep or terminate only.

Retry reuses this same task and may incur new charges when the scheduler later runs it. Skip records errors that count toward COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS only with durable receipts. Keep marks selected errors final; once no uncommitted member is undecided the task stops at FAILED. Terminate keeps all facts and never sends a request.
Terminate keeps all batches, request receipts, usage facts and decisions. It cancels the task without retrying or sending a request.
Terminate this task now? The queue will stop automatic work and keep all durable facts.
Recorded %1$d durable decision(s). Queue and task state refreshed.
The decision receipt was not confirmed. No success is claimed; refresh and review again.
Decision receipt %1$s · %2$s · batch %3$s · %4$d members · retry budget %5$d
The action did not produce a confirmed durable result.
This task is no longer awaiting a member decision.
This task is already terminal; facts are read-only.
Another task already uses this identity.
The failure batch no longer exists.
The task reached its failure batch limit.
The task reached its command limit.
The command identity conflicts with another payload.
The task is not in a state that accepts this action.
The failure evidence changed or could not be verified.
